security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A privacy-first, on-device AI chief of staff.
bundle.longDescription: Chief is an AI chief of staff that runs entirely on your machine. It talks to a local Ollama model, stores everything in a local SQLite database, and never sends your work to a remote server.
